title: config.json — typed repository configuration
description: The typed repository configuration at .verdict/config.json: versioned shared defaults and review requirements with path scopes, named work profiles, and the default profile. Structural validation comes from this schema; the hand-written parser in internal/config owns the semantic checks the schema cannot express (duplicate keys, credential keys, glob portability, clause-name uniqueness, per-group clause coverage).

defaults.description: Ordinary review defaults: flag, then environment, then repository, then personal, then built-in. Nested objects merge per field; arrays replace.

requirements.description: Conjunctive review requirements: every applicable clause must hold for compliance, and required checks accumulate across matching scopes.

profiles.description: Named work-profile descriptions keyed by profile name; scope profile fields and default_profile resolve against these names.

defaults.description: One defaults object: the pinned model roster, the estimate guard threshold, the diff cap, the chunk opt-in, the knowledge-base policy, the advisory effort tier, and the display and payload severity floors.

requirements.description: Blocking clauses with per-source thresholds, prepublication check names, and the approval bind requirement.

blockClause.description: One blocking predicate: a required name and severity threshold with optional category and path masks; absent masks mean every category or path.

scope.description: One path-scoped entry: required include globs with optional excludes plus resolution inputs — at most one of a named profile or inline defaults, with optional inline requirements.

profile.description: One work-profile description: provider-neutral depth, the checks the group must evaluate, and the lens budget.
